page_title: BOL 5-0 LAZ | Bologna v Lazio 16/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+3' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Ivan Provedel, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
90+1' The game has begun to heat up. Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
89' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bologna.
84' 5 - 0 Goal! Juan Miranda produces a brilliant lofted pass and Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) gets on the end of it to finish with a header into an empty net. The score is 5:0.
84' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Nicolo Rovella (Lazio). Andrea Colombo saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
83' Here is a change. Matias Vecino is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Arijon Ibrahimovic (Lazio).
78' The referee signals a substitution. Reda Belahyane (Lazio) is brought on as a substitute for Matteo Guendouzi.
78' The substitution is prepared. Benjamin Dominguez joins the action as a substitute, replacing Dan Ndoye (Bologna).
78' It's time for a substitution. Thijs Dallinga comes on in place of Santiago Castro (Bologna).
76' That's a clear yellow card. Santiago Castro (Bologna) goes into the book.
74' 4 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Tommaso Pobega is the provider as he slips the ball to Santiago Castro (Bologna) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 4:0.
73' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Riccardo Orsolini will be replaced by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna).
73' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Lewis Ferguson (Bologna).
72' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
71' Santiago Castro (Bologna) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Santiago Castro (Bologna) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
70' Good team movement sets up Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
69' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
69' Lazio couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) leaped high and intercepted a cross. The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
68' Santiago Castro (Bologna) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' The injury to Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
64' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
62' Substitution. Mattia Zaccagni will be replaced by Loum Tchaouna (Lazio).
62' Substitution. Boulaye Dia is replaced by Tijjani Noslin (Lazio).
59' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Jens Odgaard is replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) will replace Remo Freuler.
57' Matias Vecino (Lazio) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andrea Colombo had an easy-decision to make.
57' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) receives a pass on the edge of the box and attempts a lob as the keeper is off his line, but the effort crashes off the right post.
57' Remo Freuler (Bologna) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
49' 3 - 0 Goal! Lewis Ferguson plays it to Dan Ndoye (Bologna), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Ivan Provedel. 3:0.
48' 2 - 0 GOAL - 2:0! Dan Ndoye found Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Ivan Provedel off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
46' Half-time substitution. Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is replaced by Pedro.
46' The whistle blows and Andrea Colombo starts the second half.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Juan Miranda (Bologna) tries to get the ball up and over the defensive wall, but they easily block the effort.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Bologna are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
44' Mario Gila (Lazio) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.

42' Ambitious effort from Adam Marusic (Lazio). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
40' A pass from Santiago Castro (Bologna) is intercepted by Ivan Provedel and the move breaks down.
34' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Lukasz Skorupski.
33' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Remo Freuler (Bologna) for his blatant foul.
31' The corner from Juan Miranda (Bologna) is cleared away by the defence.
30' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

30' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Ivan Provedel pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bologna.
25' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle and it's Juan Miranda (Bologna) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
24' Good defending. Remo Freuler (Bologna) tries to find Jens Odgaard inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
22' Davide Calabria (Bologna) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
20' The free kick from long range, taken by Bologna, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
19' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) commits a rough challenge and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for an infringement.
18' Adam Marusic (Lazio) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
16' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Juan Miranda plays it into the box, and Jens Odgaard (Bologna) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 1:0.
12' Remo Freuler (Bologna) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
10' The corner from Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) is intercepted by the defence.
10' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
6' Davide Calabria (Bologna) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.

5' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
3' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bologna will have the kick-off.
Andrea Colombo will officiate today.
